name: What is slab jacking, and when is it used for driveway repair?

mainEntity.name: What is slab jacking, and when is it used for driveway repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Slab jacking, also known as mudjacking or polyjacking, is a repair method used to lift sunken concrete slabs back to their original level. It involves drilling small holes into the affected slab and injecting a grout mixture (mudjacking) or polyurethane foam (polyjacking) underneath. This material fills voids and creates upward pressure, raising the concrete. It's used when a driveway section has settled due to soil erosion, poor compaction, or expansive soils, restoring a level surface without full replacement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Slab jacking lifts sunken concrete by injecting grout or foam underneath to fill voids and raise the slab to its original level.
